card.title: Reinstate Cummer Station for North York Centre
card.what_is_proposed: A councillor brought forward a motion about reinstating Cummer Station for North York Centre.
card.why: The motion concerned a proposed transit station serving North York Centre; the agenda page does not establish approval or funding.
card.who_is_affected: Potential transit riders and people in Ward 18 (Willowdale). No station reinstatement was approved by this item.

stages.quote: City Council on May 20 and 21, 2026, received Item DM41.4 for information.

conditions: The tracking status states no further action will be taken on this item.

procedural_phrases.meaning_here: Council formally noted the item; it did not approve the station project.

uncertainties: No new meeting or consultation deadline is stated on the item page.
